I can do that, but deleting or bulk-changing email is destructive and requires a clear scope and your explicit confirmation. How would you like me to proceed? Pick one and confirm the exact wording (example confirmations shown):

Options — tell me which one you want and confirm:
1) Archive everything from that sender (remove from Inbox, keep in All Mail).
   - Search preview you can run: from:noreply@transitalerts.net
   - Confirmation example to send me: “Archive all from noreply@transitalerts.net”

2) Delete everything from that sender (moves to Trash for 30 days, then permanently deleted).
   - Search preview: from:noreply@transitalerts.net
   - Confirmation example: “Delete all from noreply@transitalerts.net”

3) Archive or delete only messages older than X days (choose days) or before a specific date.
   - Example search: from:noreply@transitalerts.net older_than:90d
   - Or: from:noreply@transitalerts.net before:2024/01/01
   - Confirmation example: “Delete from noreply@transitalerts.net older than 180 days”

4) Keep the most recent N messages and remove the rest (tell me N). I’ll need you to confirm after I show how many would be affected, or you can accept a two-step run-now action.
   - Confirmation example: “Archive all but the most recent 10 from noreply@transitalerts.net”

Tell me which option (1–4), whether you want archive or delete for options 1–3, and the exact cutoff (days/date/N) if applicable. Once you confirm precisely, I will proceed.
